summary: Round 2 fixes both prior major issues. In `tests/test_numerics/test_upper_bound.py:20-22` the old module-level `pytestmark` is gone and replaced by `_MOSEK_SKIP`, with only the SDP-dependent classes decorated at `:25`, `:50`, `:87`, `:130`, and `:319`; `TestLogNegAmplitudeDampingAnalytic` at `:169` has no skip mark. It now contains 8 tests at `:195`, `:204`, `:213`, `:223`, `:229`, `:239`, `:262`, and `:293`. I verified the class runs under pytest, and I also simulated a no-MOSEK import path by forcing `_MOSEK_AVAILABLE=False` at module import; the analytic class remained unmarked and all 8 test methods executed successfully. The 3 new tests are meaningful intermediate-step checks: `test_choi_matrix_entries` validates the explicit Choi-state formula, `test_partial_transpose_block_structure` manually reconstructs the partial transpose and checks the claimed block decomposition without calling `partial_transpose_B`, and `test_eigenvalue_set` numerically checks the full spectrum `{1/2, eta/2, 1/2, -eta/2}`. The note fix is also correct: `docs/findings/beta_G3_golden_ratio_crossover_2026-04-23.md:147-155` now states `eta=0` is the trivial boundary solution and `eta=1/phi` is the nontrivial interior crossover, with the rigor statement tightened at `:12-17`.
